title: Will measurable precipitation (>=0.01in) be recorded near Rosebud, SD on 2026-09-12?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if NWS (forecast office Aberdeen or Valentine, gridpoint nearest Rosebud SD at approx 43.23N -100.86W) reports measurable precipitation (>=0.01 inch) for 2026-09-12 via api.weather.gov climate data; NO otherwise.
